keyword.en: how to read Electric 20 Concrete Pump pumping distance
keyword.zh: 电动20型混凝土泵输送距离怎么读

title.en: What Electric 20 Concrete Pump lists, with Total station as the illustration
title.zh: 电动20型混凝土泵的距离格子按什么顺序印列出的内容，用「全站仪」做插图

description.en: Electric 20 Concrete Pump. 120 m stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Total station.
description.zh: 电动20型混凝土泵的距离格子按什么顺序印。120 m仍在目录格子里。插图来自「全站仪」。

h1.en: What Electric 20 Concrete Pump lists, with Total station as the illustration
h1.zh: 电动20型混凝土泵的距离格子按什么顺序印列出的内容，用「全站仪」做插图

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 20 Concrete Pump distance text in Xingtai as follows: Pumping Distance (H / V) is 120 m / 40 m. Read each label with its own figure. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Total_station.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动20型混凝土泵的距离文字写成：输送距离（水平/垂直）是120 m / 40 m。同一页如果同时有水平和垂直，两者不能对调；没有写出的垂直格也不能用别的型号去填。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Total_station。

body.en: The figure is the one published at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Total_station: Total station. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 20 Concrete Pump distance text in Xingtai as follows: Pumping Distance (H / V) is 120 m / 40 m. The frame “Shotcrete” shows Bauarbeiten östliches Domumfeld Kölner Dom Spritzbeton 8306 and does not replace these entries. The sheet already separates them when it lists both. Delivery Pipe Diameter 80 mm. If a distance entry is missing on the Electric 20 Concrete Pump sheet, it stays missing. Do not paste another manufacturer's boom length onto Electric 20 Concrete Pump.
body.zh: 这张图是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Total_station页上的Total station。河北品锦机械在邢台把电动20型混凝土泵的距离文字写成：输送距离（水平/垂直）是120 m / 40 m。输送距离（水平/垂直）是120 m / 40 m。电动20型混凝土泵这一页如果少了某一距离格，就让它继续空着。

body.en: Read each label with its own figure. Pumping Distance (H / V) is 120 m / 40 m. Hopper capacity is 0.25 m³. Subject: Bauarbeiten östliches Domumfeld Kölner Dom Spritzbeton 8306. Output Capacity is 8–10 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 10 MPa.
body.zh: 同一页如果同时有水平和垂直，两者不能对调；没有写出的垂直格也不能用别的型号去填。管路沿程要克服摩擦，水平段和垂直升高不是同一项工作。理论输送量是8–10 m³/h，最大出口压力是10 MPa。

body.en: Horizontal and vertical are not interchangeable when both appear, and a missing vertical entry is not filled from another model. A pipeline loses pressure to friction, so a horizontal run and a vertical rise are different duties. Maximum aggregate size is 1–2 cm. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not read a metre figure off that frame. Neither entry is a metre.
body.zh: 画面「Shotcrete」的主体是Bauarbeiten östliches Domumfeld Kölner Dom Spritzbeton 8306，不能代替这些格子。主体：Bauarbeiten östliches Domumfeld Kölner Dom Spritzbeton 8306。

question.en: Which distance text does Electric 20 Concrete Pump list?
question.zh: 电动20型混凝土泵标出了哪几句距离？

answer.en: Pumping Distance (H / V) is 120 m / 40 m. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Total_station.
answer.zh: 输送距离（水平/垂直）是120 m / 40 m。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Total_station画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Can horizontal and vertical be swapped?
question.zh: 水平和垂直可以对调吗？

answer.en: Only when the label itself puts them in that order. Keep the shown order. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Total_station.
answer.zh: 只有标题本身写成那个顺序时才按那个顺序。保留写出来的次序。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Total_station画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: Output Capacity is 8–10 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Total_station.
answer.zh: 理论输送量是8–10 m³/h。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Total_station画面里印出的数字。
